summary: Iteration 5 (customer accounts + dynamic alcohol age 16/18 + product photo upload) fully verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 21/21 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_accounts_alcohol_photos.py – auth register normalises '+41 79 111 XX YY' -> '0791111XXYY', duplicate phone -> 409, wrong password -> 401, GET/PUT /api/auth/me and full add/edit/delete /api/auth/me/addresses roundtrips. Alcohol logic: POST /api/orders with Heineken (is_alcohol=true, alcohol_type=fermented) and age_confirmed=false -> 400 mentioning '16'; with age_confirmed=true -> order.age_required=16, age_confirmed=true, user_id=null (guest); GET /api/orders/{id}/ticket contains 'CONTROLE AGE 16+'; PATCH product.alcohol_type='spirits' -> subsequent order.age_required=18 (restored to fermented after test); non-alcohol order -> age_required=null. Auth-bound checkout: POST /api/orders with Bearer + save_address=true (delivery, Marly ≥25 CHF) -> user_id set on order AND address pushed to profile; GET /api/me/orders lists the user's orders. GET /api/customers/search?phone=<5digits> returns accounts+orders including the created account; phone=2-digit -> 422 (FastAPI Query min_length). Photo pipeline: POST /api/uploads/product-photo with a generated 3000x2000 PNG -> {url:'/api/files/hallo-magic-pizza/products/<uuid>.jpg', size:<optimised>}; GET that url -> 200 image/jpeg and max(dim) <= 1600; PATCH /api/products/{id} with images:[url] + image_url persists in GET /api/menu (original restored after test). Guest checkout regression: POST /api/orders without token -> user_id null, still works. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): /account register created 'TEST_FE' with normalised phone '0797770503'; edit profile persisted; add address (Route Test, Marly 1723) then delete; logout works. Menu -> Boissons chip -> product-add-<heineken> quick-adds beer, /product/<margherita> -> size-option-32 -> add-to-cart-button. /checkout as logged-in user: coordonnées prefilled (first_name='TEST_Age', phone='0797791125'); age-confirm-checkbox visible with age-required-label='16+' and French 'Je confirme avoir 16 ans ou plus' present; submitting without ticking keeps you on checkout (blocked); ticking -> order placed and navigated to /order/<id>. Delivery mode with saved address: checkout-saved-address-<id> chip AND checkout-new-address chip present; tapping the saved chip auto-fills street='Rue Test' + npa='1723'; checkout-save-address checkbox visible under 'Nouvelle adresse'. /staff (PIN 1234) -> staff-order-card-<id> selects, staff-age-check banner reads "ALCOOL – CONTRÔLE D'ÂGE REQUIS: 16+", staff-ticket-preview -> full ticket contains 'CONTROLE AGE 16+'. After Accepter (staff-accept-15 -> staff-accept-confirm), /staff/kitchen shows a kitchen-age-* warning tile: '⚠ ALCOOL – CONTRÔLE D'ÂGE REQUIS: 16+' and text '16+'. /staff/customers with '79779' shows COMPTES CLIENTS (1) TEST_Age 0797791125 and COMMANDES PRÉCÉDENTES (1) #154 with 16+ pill. /staff/admin/product/<heineken>: 'Photos du produit' section visible with photo-main / photo-main-pick / photo-extra-add; editor-alcohol-fermented + editor-alcohol-spirits chips present; editor-alcohol-badge = '16+ · ALCOOL' by default, toggles to '18+ · ALCOOL' on spirits and back to 16+. Regression: /(tabs)/more shows more-account row navigating to /account; /(tabs)/orders renders 'Mes commandes'; menu images render (imgUri) with no red screen. No console errors beyond the pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents React Native Web deprecations.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py normalize_phone: '+41 79...' -> '0791112233' works via the len==11 branch on the digits-only string; verified by test_register_and_phone_normalisation.
auth.py login uses a dummy argon2 hash to keep the verify path constant-time when the user doesn't exist – good practice against timing oracles.

photos.py: init_storage() caches the storage_key at module level and re-inits on 503 (stale key). Good – limits round trips. Note the 402 branch returns a French error 'Stockage: crédits épuisés' – nice user-facing message.
server.py order create computes ages = [18 if alcohol_type=='spirits' else 16 ...] and sets age_required = max(ages) so mixed fermented+spirits correctly resolves to 18.
server.py /api/customers/search uses a regex on the digits – be aware regex is unescaped ; digits are guaranteed to be numeric so injection is not an issue but worth documenting.

pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; iter5 suite shares STATE across classes so it must be run with -n 0 (as the file docstring implies with sequential auth->orders->photos ordering). Consider making classes independent (session-scoped bootstrap fixture) or note the -n 0 requirement in the pytest.ini agent hint. Current suite passes 21/21 when run with -n 0.
photo-manager exposes photo-main / photo-main-pick / photo-extra-add testIDs — good. Native file picker cannot be automated in Playwright but the UI presence is verified.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created ~6 orders (all prefixed TEST_) via POST /api/orders and one uploaded photo (mongo product image_url restored to original after test). Frontend session created 3 test user accounts: 0797770503 (TEST_FE2), 0797791125 (TEST_Age – order #154 Heineken+Margherita 32cm CHF 17.50, age_required=16, accepted, moved to kitchen), 0797719813 (TEST_Deliv, with saved address 'Maison' Rue Test 9 / 1723 Marly). These non-destructive test accounts remain in DB; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run this iter's backend suite serially: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter5_accounts_alcohol_photos.py -n 0 -v` (pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope splits classes across workers and breaks the shared STATE dict). Product IDs: heineken=6aa94a928068d15c2420fa17, margherita=6aa94a928068d15c2420f9e5.
